g.text: Tell me of this terrible god you have unleashed
Your Xipe Totec, your flayed god
You think but you do not know
But yet you think its an enemy ¿Por qué?
You treat him like an enemy though
If you do not know what he is after
This void creature that sacrifices others and wears their skin like ancient flayed god of old, Xipe Totec
That THING decided it'd be a fun experiment to turn the parents on the Zariman against their children -
All it does is leave death and destruction in its wake. No matter what it's motivations are, it doesn't matter. Trust me.
And then gave the children magical void powers so they could murder their own parents so it could LEARN from the slaughter.
Trust you to understand the mind of a god
Don't care how old you are
It's had an opportunity to learn from love, from sacrifice, from kindness. But it seems to CHOOSE to seek out chaos and murder.
Even if it's just a toddler smashing toys together to understand the world around it, we're those toys. It has to be stopped.
I'll continue to hold out hope it isn't an enemy, but... it's not giving me a lot of reasons to think it isn't.
I refuse to believe it's benign after all I've seen. After all it's done to me.
You are not a god babas
Don't pretend you think like one
Otherwise you are no better than that Entrati cabrón
And you think you can stop a god
You are not a god babas
Don't pretend you think like one
Otherwise you are no better than those orokin cabrones
You are not a god babas
Don't pretend you think like one
No clue. I tend to make this shit up as I go. lol
I think I can try. Like I did here. And that's all any of us can do.
It's up to others, now. My place is here in 1999 with all of you.
The moment they ring you will go running
You are a drifter, a soldier, you will go to save the future when they need you
Seems to work for you, so I won't judge
All we can ask for I suppose
Do not lie to me or tell me you'll take me for walks, babas
Someday you will escape and never come back
Faith in what does not matter I suppose
As long as it gets you through
Chat ends. Next chat will be LettieEscape.
